title: STZ: A High Quality and High Speed Streaming Lossy Compression Framework for Scientific Data
problem: Error-bounded lossy compression degrades compression quality and speed when supporting both progressive and random-access decompression.
motivation: Scientific data volume reduction requires compression framework supporting both progressive and random-access decompression without sacrificing quality or speed.
method: STZ streaming compression framework with hierarchical partitioning strategy and hierarchical prediction mechanism; enables both progressive and random-access decompression.
key_novelty: First compression framework simultaneously supporting both progressive and random-access decompression; hierarchical strategy mitigates partitioning impact.
contributions: First framework enabling both progressive and random-access decompression
6.7x faster than SZ3 with comparable quality
